title: Docs and --help advertise CLI commands that are stubs or absent
description:
README.md:94 lists the CLI as 'whoami, enumerate, fetch-jwt, enroll app, delegate, etc.' Two problems: 'enroll app' now exits 1 (closed as persona-5s4b.103), and 'delegate' is not in the dispatch table at persona/src/main.rs at all -- the README names a command that has never existed. The capability table at README.md:31 is in the same voice, and SPEC-HIA.md:336-337 documents 'persona enroll app' and 'persona enroll origin' as authorization commands.

In --help (main.rs:121,125), 'fetch-x509  fetch an X.509-SVID from the daemon' describes a function that prints a sentence, and 'trust-bundle  list or manage trust bundles' advertises manage, i.e. add and remove, both stubs. The enroll line was corrected in cd382e7; these were left because they belong to other commands.

Note SPEC-HIA.md is normative, so deciding whether enroll is removed from the spec or kept as unimplemented-but-specified is Mark's call, not a docs edit.
acceptance_criteria: No doc or help text names a command that does not exist or claims a stub works. SPEC-HIA treatment of enroll decided explicitly.
